preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some LuffyInu tokens to sell
Attacker must NOT be the owner and NOT be in excludeFee mapping

violation_target.exploit_hint: The contract deducts liquidity fees but doesn't add them to the pair's reserves. When selling tokens to the pair, the liquidity fee is transferred to the pair address but not added to reserves, creating an imbalance. Attack by: 1. Ensure taxStatus is true, 2. Sell tokens to the uniswapV2Pair, 3. The liquidity fee (1%) is sent to pair address but not added to reserves, 4. This creates an arbitrage opportunity where you can buy back tokens at a discount since reserves don't reflect the actual token balance.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract's _transfer function sends liquidity fees (1%) to the pair address when selling tokens, but doesn't update the pair's reserves. This creates a discrepancy where the pair has more tokens than its reserves indicate, making tokens undervalued. An attacker can sell tokens to trigger this fee, then buy back at a discount.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Acquire LuffyInu tokens. 2. Sell tokens via PancakeSwap router to trigger the flawed fee logic. 3. The liquidity fee (1%) is sent to pair but reserves aren't updated. 4. Buy back tokens at a discount due to the reserve imbalance. 5. Profit from the price discrepancy.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use deal() to give attacker LuffyInu tokens. 2. Approve router to spend tokens. 3. Sell tokens via swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens. 4. Check pair reserves before and after to confirm imbalance. 5. Buy back tokens with ETH. 6. Convert tokens back to ETH to realize profit.
